RHYDON.text:
Protected by an
armor-like hide,
it is capable of
living in molten
lava of 3,600
degrees

KANGASKHAN.text:
The infant rarely
ventures out of
its mother's
protective pouch
until it is 3
years old

NIDORANM.text:
Stiffens its ears
to sense danger.
The larger its
horns, the more
powerful its
secreted venom

CLEFAIRY.text:
Its magical and
cute appeal has
many admirers.
It is rare and
found only in
certain areas

SPEAROW.text:
Eats bugs in
grassy areas. It
has to flap its
short wings at
high speed to
stay airborne

VOLTORB.text:
Usually found in
power plants.
Easily mistaken
for a POKé BALL,
they have zapped
many people

NIDOKING.text:
It uses its
powerful tail in
battle to smash,
constrict, then
break the prey's
bones

SLOWBRO.text:
The SHELLDER that
is latched onto
SLOWPOKE's tail
is said to feed
on the host's left
over scraps

IVYSAUR.text:
When the bulb on
its back grows
large, it appears
to lose the
ability to stand
on its hind legs

EXEGGUTOR.text:
Legend has it that
on rare occasions,
one of its heads
will drop off and
continue on as an
EXEGGCUTE

LICKITUNG.text:
Its tongue can be
extended like a
chameleon's. It
leaves a tingling
sensation when it
licks enemies

EXEGGCUTE.text:
Often mistaken
for eggs.
When disturbed,
they quickly
gather and attack
in swarms

GRIMER.text:
Appears in filthy
areas. Thrives by
sucking up
polluted sludge
that is pumped
out of factories

GENGAR.text:
Under a full moon,
this POKéMON
likes to mimic
the shadows of
people and laugh
at their fright

NIDORANF.text:
Although small,
its venomous
barbs render this
POKéMON dangerous.
The female has
smaller horns

NIDOQUEEN.text:
Its hard scales
provide strong
protection. It
uses its hefty
bulk to execute
powerful moves

CUBONE.text:
Because it never
removes its skull
helmet, no one
has ever seen
this POKéMON's
real face

RHYHORN.text:
Its massive bones
are 1000 times
harder than human
bones. It can
easily knock a
trailer flying

LAPRAS.text:
A POKéMON that
has been over-
hunted almost to
extinction. It
can ferry people
across the water

ARCANINE.text:
A POKéMON that
has been admired
since the past
for its beauty.
It runs agilely
as if on wings

MEW.text:
So rare that it
is still said to
be a mirage by
many experts. Only
a few people have
seen it worldwide

GYARADOS.text:
Rarely seen in
the wild. Huge
and vicious, it
is capable of
destroying entire
cities in a rage

SHELLDER.text:
Its hard shell
repels any kind
of attack.
It is vulnerable
only when its
shell is open

TENTACOOL.text:
Drifts in shallow
seas. Anglers who
hook them by
accident are
often punished by
its stinging acid

GASTLY.text:
Almost invisible,
this gaseous
POKéMON cloaks
the target and
puts it to sleep
without notice

SCYTHER.text:
With ninja-like
agility and speed,
it can create the
illusion that
there is more
than one

STARYU.text:
An enigmatic
POKéMON that can
effortlessly
regenerate any
appendage it
loses in battle

BLASTOISE.text:
A brutal POKéMON
with pressurized
water jets on its
shell. They are
used for high
speed tackles

PINSIR.text:
If it fails to
crush the victim
in its pincers,
it will swing it
around and toss
it hard

TANGELA.text:
The whole body is
swathed with wide
vines that are
similar to sea-
weed. Its vines
shake as it walks

GROWLITHE.text:
Very protective
of its territory.
It will bark and
bite to repel
intruders from
its space

ONIX.text:
As it grows, the
stone portions of
its body harden
to become similar
to a diamond, but
colored black

FEAROW.text:
With its huge and
magnificent wings,
it can keep aloft
without ever
having to land
for rest

PIDGEY.text:
A common sight in
forests and woods.
It flaps its
wings at ground
level to kick up
blinding sand

SLOWPOKE.text:
Incredibly slow
and dopey. It
takes 5 seconds
for it to feel
pain when under
attack

KADABRA.text:
It emits special
alpha waves from
its body that
induce headaches
just by being
close by

GRAVELER.text:
Rolls down slopes
to move. It rolls
over any obstacle
without slowing
or changing its
direction

CHANSEY.text:
A rare and elusive
POKéMON that is
said to bring
happiness to those
who manage to get
it

MACHOKE.text:
Its muscular body
is so powerful, it
must wear a power
save belt to be
able to regulate
its motions

MRMIME.text:
If interrupted
while it is
miming, it will
slap around the
offender with its
broad hands

HITMONLEE.text:
When in a hurry,
its legs lengthen
progressively.
It runs smoothly
with extra long,
loping strides

HITMONCHAN.text:
While apparently
doing nothing, it
fires punches in
lightning fast
volleys that are
impossible to see

ARBOK.text:
It is rumored that
the ferocious
warning markings
on its belly
differ from area
to area

PARASECT.text:
A host-parasite
pair in which the
parasite mushroom
has taken over the
host bug. Prefers
damp places

PSYDUCK.text:
While lulling its
enemies with its
vacant look, this
wily POKéMON will
use psychokinetic
powers

DROWZEE.text:
Puts enemies to
sleep then eats
their dreams.
Occasionally gets
sick from eating
bad dreams

GOLEM.text:
Its boulder-like
body is extremely
hard. It can
easily withstand
dynamite blasts
without damage

MAGMAR.text:
Its body always
burns with an
orange glow that
enables it to
hide perfectly
among flames

ELECTABUZZ.text:
Normally found
near power plants,
they can wander
away and cause
major blackouts
in cities

MAGNETON.text:
Formed by several
MAGNEMITEs linked
together. They
frequently appear
when sunspots
flare up

KOFFING.text:
Because it stores
several kinds of
toxic gases in
its body, it is
prone to exploding
without warning

MANKEY.text:
Extremely quick to
anger. It could
be docile one
moment then
thrashing away
the next instant

SEEL.text:
The protruding
horn on its head
is very hard.
It is used for
bashing through
thick ice

DIGLETT.text:
Lives about one
yard underground
where it feeds on
plant roots. It
sometimes appears
above ground

TAUROS.text:
When it targets
an enemy, it
charges furiously
while whipping its
body with its
long tails

FARFETCHD.text:
The sprig of
green onions it
holds is its
weapon. It is
used much like a
metal sword

VENONAT.text:
Lives in the
shadows of tall
trees where it
eats insects. It
is attracted by
light at night

DRAGONITE.text:
An extremely
rarely seen
marine POKéMON.
Its intelligence
is said to match
that of humans

DODUO.text:
A bird that makes
up for its poor
flying with its
fast foot speed.
Leaves giant
footprints

POLIWAG.text:
Its newly grown
legs prevent it
from running. It
appears to prefer
swimming than
trying to stand

JYNX.text:
It seductively
wiggles its hips
as it walks. It
can cause people
to dance in
unison with it

MOLTRES.text:
Known as the
legendary bird of
fire. Every flap
of its wings
creates a dazzling
flash of flames

ARTICUNO.text:
A legendary bird
POKéMON that is
said to appear to
doomed people who
are lost in icy
mountains

ZAPDOS.text:
A legendary bird
POKéMON that is
said to appear
from clouds while
dropping enormous
lightning bolts

DITTO.text:
Capable of copying
an enemy's genetic
code to instantly
transform itself
into a duplicate
of the enemy

MEOWTH.text:
Adores circular
objects. Wanders
the streets on a
nightly basis to
look for dropped
loose change

KRABBY.text:
Its pincers are
not only powerful
weapons, they are
used for balance
when walking
sideways

VULPIX.text:
At the time of
birth, it has
just one tail.
The tail splits
from its tip as
it grows older

NINETALES.text:
Very smart and
very vengeful.
Grabbing one of
its many tails
could result in a
1000-year curse

PIKACHU.text:
When several of
these POKéMON
gather, their
electricity could
build and cause
lightning storms

RAICHU.text:
Its long tail
serves as a
ground to protect
itself from its
own high voltage
power

DRATINI.text:
Long considered a
mythical POKéMON
until recently
when a small
colony was found
living underwater

DRAGONAIR.text:
A mystical POKéMON
that exudes a
gentle aura.
Has the ability
to change climate
conditions

KABUTO.text:
A POKéMON that
was resurrected
from a fossil
found in what was
once the ocean
floor eons ago

KABUTOPS.text:
Its sleek shape is
perfect for swim-
ming. It slashes
prey with its
claws and drains
the body fluids

HORSEA.text:
Known to shoot
down flying bugs
with precision
blasts of ink
from the surface
of the water

SEADRA.text:
Capable of swim-
ming backwards by
rapidly flapping
its wing-like
pectoral fins and
stout tail

SANDSHREW.text:
Burrows deep
underground in
arid locations
far from water.
It only emerges
to hunt for food

SANDSLASH.text:
Curls up into a
spiny ball when
threatened. It
can roll while
curled up to
attack or escape

OMANYTE.text:
Although long
extinct, in rare
cases, it can be
genetically
resurrected from
fossils

OMASTAR.text:
A prehistoric
POKéMON that died
out when its
heavy shell made
it impossible to
catch prey

JIGGLYPUFF.text:
When its huge eyes
light up, it sings
a mysteriously
soothing melody
that lulls its
enemies to sleep

WIGGLYTUFF.text:
The body is soft
and rubbery. When
angered, it will
suck in air and
inflate itself to
an enormous size

EEVEE.text:
Its genetic code
is irregular.
It may mutate if
it is exposed to
radiation from
element STONEs

FLAREON.text:
When storing
thermal energy in
its body, its
temperature could
soar to over 1600
degrees

JOLTEON.text:
It accumulates
negative ions in
the atmosphere to
blast out 10000-
volt lightning
bolts

VAPOREON.text:
Lives close to
water. Its long
tail is ridged
with a fin which
is often mistaken
for a mermaid's

MACHOP.text:
Loves to build
its muscles.
It trains in all
styles of martial
arts to become
even stronger

ZUBAT.text:
Forms colonies in
perpetually dark
places. Uses
ultrasonic waves
to identify and
approach targets

EKANS.text:
Moves silently
and stealthily.
Eats the eggs of
birds, such as
PIDGEY and
SPEAROW, whole

PARAS.text:
Burrows to suck
tree roots. The
mushrooms on its
back grow by draw-
ing nutrients from
the bug host

POLIWHIRL.text:
Capable of living
in or out of
water. When out
of water, it
sweats to keep
its body slimy

POLIWRATH.text:
An adept swimmer
at both the front
crawl and breast
stroke. Easily
overtakes the best
human swimmers

WEEDLE.text:
Often found in
forests, eating
leaves.
It has a sharp
venomous stinger
on its head

KAKUNA.text:
Almost incapable
of moving, this
POKéMON can only
harden its shell
to protect itself
from predators

BEEDRILL.text:
Flies at high
speed and attacks
using its large
venomous stingers
on its forelegs
and tail

DODRIO.text:
Uses its three
brains to execute
complex plans.
While two heads
sleep, one head
stays awake

PRIMEAPE.text:
Always furious
and tenacious to
boot. It will not
abandon chasing
its quarry until
it is caught

DUGTRIO.text:
A team of DIGLETT
triplets.
It triggers huge
earthquakes by
burrowing 60 miles
underground

VENOMOTH.text:
The dust-like
scales covering
its wings are
color coded to
indicate the kinds
of poison it has

DEWGONG.text:
Stores thermal
energy in its
body. Swims at a
steady 8 knots
even in intensely
cold waters

CATERPIE.text:
Its short feet
are tipped with
suction pads that
enable it to
tirelessly climb
slopes and walls

METAPOD.text:
This POKéMON is
vulnerable to
attack while its
shell is soft,
exposing its weak
and tender body

BUTTERFREE.text:
In battle, it
flaps its wings
at high speed to
release highly
toxic dust into
the air

MACHAMP.text:
Using its heavy
muscles, it throws
powerful punches
that can send the
victim clear over
the horizon

GOLDUCK.text:
Often seen swim-
ming elegantly by
lake shores. It
is often mistaken
for the Japanese
monster, Kappa

HYPNO.text:
When it locks eyes
with an enemy, it
will use a mix of
PSI moves such as
HYPNOSIS and
CONFUSION

GOLBAT.text:
Once it strikes,
it will not stop
draining energy
from the victim
even if it gets
too heavy to fly

MEWTWO.text:
It was created by
a scientist after
years of horrific
gene splicing and
DNA engineering
experiments

SNORLAX.text:
Very lazy. Just
eats and sleeps.
As its rotund
bulk builds, it
becomes steadily
more slothful

MAGIKARP.text:
In the distant
past, it was
somewhat stronger
than the horribly
weak descendants
that exist today

MUK.text:
Thickly covered
with a filthy,
vile sludge. It
is so toxic, even
its footprints
contain poison

KINGLER.text:
The large pincer
has 10000 hp of
crushing power.
However, its huge
size makes it
unwieldy to use

CLOYSTER.text:
When attacked, it
launches its
horns in quick
volleys. Its
innards have
never been seen

ELECTRODE.text:
It stores electric
energy under very
high pressure.
It often explodes
with little or no
provocation

CLEFABLE.text:
A timid fairy
POKéMON that is
rarely seen. It
will run and hide
the moment it
senses people

WEEZING.text:
Where two kinds
of poison gases
meet, 2 KOFFINGs
can fuse into a
WEEZING over many
years

PERSIAN.text:
Although its fur
has many admirers,
it is tough to
raise as a pet
because of its
fickle meanness

MAROWAK.text:
The bone it holds
is its key weapon.
It throws the
bone skillfully
like a boomerang
to KO targets

HAUNTER.text:
Because of its
ability to slip
through block
walls, it is said
to be from an-
other dimension

ABRA.text:
Using its ability
to read minds, it
will identify
impending danger
and TELEPORT to
safety

ALAKAZAM.text:
Its brain can out-
perform a super-
computer.
Its intelligence
quotient is said
to be 5,000

PIDGEOTTO.text:
Very protective
of its sprawling
territorial area,
this POKéMON will
fiercely peck at
any intruder

PIDGEOT.text:
When hunting, it
skims the surface
of water at high
speed to pick off
unwary prey such
as MAGIKARP

STARMIE.text:
Its central core
glows with the
seven colors of
the rainbow. Some
people value the
core as a gem

BULBASAUR.text:
A strange seed was
planted on its
back at birth.
The plant sprouts
and grows with
this POKéMON

VENUSAUR.text:
The plant blooms
when it is
absorbing solar
energy. It stays
on the move to
seek sunlight

TENTACRUEL.text:
The tentacles are
normally kept
short. On hunts,
they are extended
to ensnare and
immobilize prey

GOLDEEN.text:
Its tail fin
billows like an
elegant ballroom
dress, giving it
the nickname of
the Water Queen

SEAKING.text:
In the autumn
spawning season,
they can be seen
swimming power-
fully up rivers
and creeks

PONYTA.text:
Its hooves are 10
times harder than
diamonds. It can
trample anything
completely flat
in little time

RAPIDASH.text:
Very competitive,
this POKéMON will
chase anything
that moves fast
in the hopes of
racing it

RATTATA.text:
Bites anything
when it attacks.
Small and very
quick, it is a
common sight in
many places

RATICATE.text:
It uses its whis-
kers to maintain
its balance.
It apparently
slows down if
they are cut off

NIDORINO.text:
An aggressive
POKéMON that is
quick to attack.
The horn on its
head secretes a
powerful venom

NIDORINA.text:
The female's horn
develops slowly.
Prefers physical
attacks such as
clawing and
biting

GEODUDE.text:
Found in fields
and mountains.
Mistaking them
for boulders,
people often step
or trip on them

PORYGON.text:
A POKéMON that
consists entirely
of programming
code. Capable of
moving freely in
cyberspace

AERODACTYL.text:
A ferocious, pre-
historic POKéMON
that goes for the
enemy's throat
with its serrated
saw-like fangs

MAGNEMITE.text:
Uses anti-gravity
to stay suspended.
Appears without
warning and uses
THUNDER WAVE and
similar moves

CHARMANDER.text:
Obviously prefers
hot places. When
it rains, steam
is said to spout
from the tip of
its tail

SQUIRTLE.text:
After birth, its
back swells and
hardens into a
shell. Powerfully
sprays foam from
its mouth

CHARMELEON.text:
When it swings
its burning tail,
it elevates the
temperature to
unbearably high
levels

WARTORTLE.text:
Often hides in
water to stalk
unwary prey. For
swimming fast, it
moves its ears to
maintain balance

CHARIZARD.text:
Spits fire that
is hot enough to
melt boulders.
Known to cause
forest fires
unintentionally

ODDISH.text:
During the day,
it keeps its face
buried in the
ground. At night,
it wanders around
sowing its seeds

GLOOM.text:
The fluid that
oozes from its
mouth isn't drool.
It is a nectar
that is used to
attract prey

VILEPLUME.text:
The larger its
petals, the more
toxic pollen it
contains. Its big
head is heavy and
hard to hold up

BELLSPROUT.text:
A carnivorous
POKéMON that traps
and eats bugs.
It uses its root
feet to soak up
needed moisture

WEEPINBELL.text:
It spits out
POISONPOWDER to
immobilize the
enemy and then
finishes it with
a spray of ACID

VICTREEBEL.text:
Said to live in
huge colonies
deep in jungles,
although no one
has ever returned
from there
